text:
anita: Quick hit — experiment idea for pricing/pack page. After someone finishes the cost calculator, show a 1-question micro-qualifier and route them: high-commitment results -> demo booking CTA + sales route; mid/low -> webinar nurture + self-serve. Keeps the page compact but surfaces intent. Thoughts?

jamie: I like it. Can we also show a 1-line FAQ blurb when the slider is in the committed range? e.g., "Committed tier = reserved GPU pools + SLA (contact sales)". Short copy only.

leo: Design note — we should avoid modal overload. Micro-qualifier can be an inline panel under the calculator results with two CTAs. I'll mock options (primary demo, secondary webinar).

priya: routing logistics: Sales Ops prefers leads with > $1k/mo ARR equivalent to go to SDR queue; anything below to webinar nurture. Need the exact threshold from analytics. Also want an event param for lead_type.

marcus: threshold idea OK. We'll run an A/A first for 2 weeks to baseline. Event schema proposal:
```
dataLayer.push({
  event: 'pricing_qualifier',
  result_bucket: 'committed|considering|low',
  calc_value_usd: 1250,
  lead_route: 'sdr|webinar|selfserve'
});
```
I'll add KPIs: demo conversions, webinar signups, downstream MQL % after 30d.

elena: CS input — if we route to sales, include a one-liner that mentions privacy: "We don't share your prompt data without consent" so regulated customers feel safe. Also add an FAQ anchor link for compliance.

anita: Nice. For messaging iteration, let's test two headline variants in the micro-qualifier: "Get a tailored demo for high-volume usage" vs "See how to lower per-token cost for committed workloads". We can AB them.

jamie: Also propose we trial alternate tier naming in the qualifier outcomes, not the main page, to avoid full-page churn. Options: "Reserved", "Burst", "Managed" vs "Dedicated", "Flexible", "Hosted". Use language laddering in copy tests.

leo: I'll include the tier labels in the mock and show primary/descriptive microcopy under each.

priya: FYI — need the webhook payload shape for SDR routing. Marcus, can you add in the spec so Eng can implement?

marcus: Yep. Will draft in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-pricing-qualifier-spec (placeholder). Will include sample payload + GA events.

anita: Timeline proposal: mock by Tue, analytics + routing spec by Wed, small build by Fri for internal QA, soft launch to 10% traffic next Tue. Agree?

jamie: Agree. I'll prep two FAQ blurb variants and the microcopy matrix.

leo: Mocking now. ETA end of day.

priya: Heads-up to Sales: /cc @sales-team — expect flow change next week.

deploy-bot: new deploy scheduled: marketing/feature/pricing-qualifier -> staging at 2026-04-22T14:00:00Z :rocket:

elena: Can we add a short webinar tie-in: "Intro to Dedicated capacity" — use the qualifier to seed invites for people who fall into committed or considering buckets. Less noise for self-serve.

anita: Good call. We'll add a nurture chain: committed -> sales demo + webinar invite, considering -> webinar only, low -> email tips + signup CTA.

marcus: Measurement checklist: baseline CTR on pricing CTA, post-qualifier demo booking rate, webinar attendance rate, 30d trial->paid. I'll add tracking ids for each variant.

jamie: Copy snippet for FAQ (variant A): "What does Committed mean? Committed customers reserve GPU capacity and receive a 99.9% uptime SLA; billing options include reserved and metered plans. Contact sales for enterprise pricing."

jamie: Copy snippet for FAQ (variant B): "Committed = reserved throughput + priority support. Ideal for predictable high-throughput apps. Not sure? Use the calculator or book a quick demo."

anita: Love both. We'll run headline + FAQ A/Bs together. Keep the calculator UX identical.

leo: Quick microcopy tweak request: replace the word "Committed" with a more customer-facing label in the qualifier (e.g., "Reserved plan") and show the backend tag "committed" only in events.

priya: Good. That helps SDRs.

marcus: I'll include mapping table: frontend_label -> backend_bucket.

anita: Ok final ask — can eng add a small debounce so repeated calculator changes don't re-fire route events too often? Want a single event when user clicks the qualifier CTA.

marcus: Noted. That's in the spec.

deploy-bot: staging deploy succeeded: marketing/pricing-qualifier @ 2026-04-22T14:02:10Z :white_check_mark:

anita: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the test dashboard and the rollout checklist in the doc. :thumbsup:
